answers.core: I think this is a growth problem that the engine will face sooner or later, as a lot of users will want to use different effects on a lot of different objects with different materials.
answers.workaround:
You can simply replace dozens or hundreds of materials with shaders, but this is not as convenient as standard materials.

There is a similar proposal https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/944 , but mine is a little different. I would like to keep the standard appearance of the material (it is more familiar and easier to configure), just by specifying a link to the code with additional features, such as exposure to rain, burning, and so on..

title: Add an option for custom shader functions to materials
